description: This file defines a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer for C# that enforces rules on the return types of methods in Orleans grain interface definitions, specifically ensuring they return compatible asynchronous types such as Task, ValueTask, or void.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn analyzer that validates method return types in Orleans grain interface definitions to be from a set of supported asynchronous types or void.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method declaration syntax nodes to verify if they belong to the correct interface and if their return types are supported.

methods.name: NamespacesEqual
methods.description: Compares namespace symbols with a list of namespace parts to determine if they are equivalent.
